items.title: Bass X Machina
items.synopsis: In a lawless Steampunk West overrun by brutal outlaws, machines, and supernatural terrors, a father is forced to become judge, jury, and executioner—knowing that every act of justice meant to protect his family may ultimately cost him the very people he's fighting to save.
items.brief: A father becomes judge and executioner in a lawless Steampunk West to protect his family.

items.title: Mike Tyson: Return of the Mike
items.synopsis: The former heavyweight champion returns to the stage for a raw one-man show, turning his wildest life stories into comedy gold at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino.
items.brief: Former heavyweight champion Mike Tyson performs stand-up comedy about his life.

items.title: Dead-End Job
items.synopsis: Dead-End Job follows, a young man who takes on a seemingly perfect part-time job offering 50 times the usual hourly wage through a mysterious employment agency called Spyder Human Resource Center. However, the job quickly becomes a nightmare as he encounters strange and terrifying phenomena.
items.brief: A young man's mysteriously high-paying job quickly becomes a nightmare of strange terror.

items.title: Bytet
items.synopsis: Helene and Carl trade their home in Stockholm's archipelago for a sun-drenched villa in Sicily, swapping lives for some weeks with Scarlett and Adam; a couple they've never met. But as they settle into each other's houses, unsettling details begin to surface. As secrets emerge and hidden betrayals come to light, what started as a picture‑perfect escape slowly warps into a twisted game of surveillance, manipulation and mistrust.
items.brief: Two couples swap homes between Sweden and Sicily, only to uncover secrets and betrayals.

items.title: How to Ruin Diwali: Meet the Parents
items.synopsis: A hidden engagement forces a proud Zulu family and an Indian medical dynasty under one roof as secrets and colliding customs threaten to derail Diwali.
items.brief: A hidden engagement forces a Zulu family and Indian medical dynasty together at Diwali.

items.title: Obsess
items.synopsis: A jealous ex's "separation magic" incantation targets a loving couple's marriage — unleashing a dark wave of black magic in this folklore-rooted horror.
items.brief: A jealous ex's black magic curse threatens a couple's marriage in this folklore horror.

items.title: Akka
items.synopsis: Power, revenge and legacy collide when rebel Rudra targets Bhavani's matriarchal rule over Pernuru in this gripping drama from YRF.
items.brief: Rebel Rudra challenges matriarch Bhavani's rule over Pernuru in this gripping drama.

items.title: Beat Luke Littler / Live Event
items.synopsis: The second and final season of the American streaming television series Luke Cage, which is based on the Marvel Comics character of the same name, sees Luke Cage become a hero and celebrity in Harlem after clearing his name, only to face a new threat.…
items.brief: Luke Cage becomes a hero and celebrity in Harlem but faces a dangerous new threat.

items.title: Collision Course
items.synopsis: Collision Course unravels the speculation surrounding car and airplane crashes involving celebrities relying on footage from the scene, police records, CGI reenactments and interviews with eyewitnesses to provide a detailed look at what put these celebrities on a collision course. Episodes include Paul Walker, Tracy Morgan, John Denver, Justin Bieber and John F. Kennedy Jr.
items.brief: Documentary examining celebrity crashes through footage, records, and eyewitness accounts.

items.title: SCTV: The Greatest Show You’ve Never Heard Of
items.synopsis: Legendary "SCTV" cast members reunite in this documentary for a funny and heartfelt celebration of how a scrappy Canadian sketch show made comedy history.
items.brief: Legendary "SCTV" cast members reunite in this documentary for a funny and heartfelt celebration of how.

items.title: The Birthday Gift
items.synopsis: Single mother Marlene Frischmann organizes a birthday party for her son Theo at her brother's chic country villa, which quickly spirals into family drama, world-view quarrels, and chaos.
items.brief: A birthday party for Theo at a country villa spirals into family drama and chaos.

items.title: Balaraw
items.synopsis: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.
items.brief: A woman searches an uncharted island for her vanished mother and family secrets.

items.title: La Caída de El Mayo
items.synopsis: On July 25, 2024, Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada García, co-founder of the Sinaloa Cartel and one of the most wanted individuals sought by authorities for decades, landed at a small airport in New Mexico aboard a private plane alongside Joaquín Guzmán López, son of El Chapo, where he was taken into U.S. custody. Was it a kidnapping, a betrayal, or a covert operation?
items.brief: Drug kingpin El Mayo lands in New Mexico and is taken into U.S. custody in July 2024.

items.title: You, Me, Us
items.synopsis: A couple faces the difficult path to adoption, determined to become parents despite their complex vulnerabilities.
items.brief: A couple navigates the difficult path to adoption, determined to become parents.

items.title: Midnight Diner: Tokyo Stories (Season 3)
items.synopsis: In a back alley of a busy district sits a small eatery called Meshiya, referred to by its patrons as the Midnight Diner. The little joint, which the Master runs by himself, is open only from midnight to 7:00 AM. The menu consists only of a pork miso soup set, beer, saké and shochu, but the Master's policy is to make whatever his customers request. Tonight, like every other night, a menagerie of customers flock to the Midnight Diner, where the bonds among the Master, his food and the patrons set the stage for humorous and sometimes wistful episodes of human drama that feed both the belly and the soul.
items.brief: Late-night diner owner serves food and listens to patrons' stories from midnight to dawn.

items.title: Dom de Iludir
items.synopsis: Amid the glamour and privilege of Rio de Janeiro's elite, art collector Lúcia Rossetti and her daughter, Maíra Rossetti, are caught in a complex and turbulent relationship. When their lives intersect with Irina, a web of secrets, tensions and mysteries begins to unfold.
items.brief: Art collector Lúcia and daughter Maíra's lives become entangled with Irina's secrets.

items.title: The One About Matthew Perry
items.synopsis: Told through intimate testimonies from close family and friends, The One About Matthew Perry reveals the real Matthew Perry - generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life - and the battles he fought to become the man behind the icon.
items.brief: Intimate documentary reveals the real Matthew Perry through family and friends' testimonies.

items.title: Zainab Johnson: Toxically Optimistic
items.synopsis: Zainab Johnson has a gun revelation, a Tesla crisis and an unshakable belief that she can find the upside in everything in this sharp stand-up hour.
items.brief: Comedian Zainab Johnson finds the upside in gun reveals, Tesla crises, and life's chaos.

items.title: Day of the Dead: Ofrenda
items.synopsis: An ofrenda that never goes dark: Keep this experience glowing and let Day of the Dead fill your space with memory and tradition.
items.brief: Experience celebrating Day of the Dead traditions and memory through an interactive ofrenda.

items.title: Minimum Wage
items.synopsis: Teens struggle to run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss and minimum wage in this series based on the hit social media shorts.
items.brief: Teens run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss, and minimum wage.

items.title: Lupin (Season 4)
items.synopsis: Inspired by the adventures of Arsène Lupin, gentleman thief Assane Diop sets out to avenge his father for an injustice inflicted by a wealthy family.
items.brief: Gentleman thief Assane Diop avenges his father against a wealthy family.

items.title: Grande de España
items.synopsis: Don Leandro, a ruined marquis who lives on appearances and dreams of being named a Grandee of Spain, sees only one way out of his financial disaster: selling his decaying family mansion in Madrid. The perfect opportunity seems to arise when the immensely wealthy businesswoman Sofía Carrington takes an interest in the property. But as the negotiations (and seductions) progress, it becomes clear that they are not who they appear to be.
items.brief: Ruined marquis Don Leandro plots to sell his mansion to wealthy businesswoman Sofía Carrington.

items.title: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
items.synopsis: Blurring the line between performance and personal crisis, comedian Maria Bamford turns her mental health journey into material that’s riotously funny and ultimately inspiring. What emerges is a portrait of an artist transforming vulnerability into creative strength through honesty.
items.brief: Comedian Maria Bamford transforms her mental health journey into riotously funny material.

items.title: Surviving Hurricane Otis
items.synopsis: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.
items.brief: Estranged brothers survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco and rebuild their bond.

items.title: Gajab Raat
items.synopsis: A corrupt, troubled cop's night spirals out of control when a reluctant act of mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.
items.brief: Corrupt cop's mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.

items.title: Nobody Wants This (Season 3)
items.synopsis: An agnostic sex podcaster and a rabbi walk into a party. No, it's not the start of a joke — it's the beginning of a love story. And it's complicated.
items.brief: Sex podcaster and rabbi fall in love despite their incompatible lifestyles.

items.title: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?
items.synopsis: Once Japan's most renowned actor, Gen is suddenly forgotten. Fueled by a need for recognition, he claws his way back from zero in this comedy.
items.brief: Forgotten actor Gen claws his way back from zero in this comedy.

items.title: Couldn’t Agree Less with Allison & Isaac (Podcast)
items.synopsis: Real-life couple Allison Kuch and Isaac Rochell invite viewers into their messiest, most honest disagreements — tackling everything from money and parenting to jealousy and in-laws through audience submissions, guest perspectives, and pop culture debates.
items.brief: Real-life couple Allison Kuch and Isaac Rochell invite viewers into their messiest, most honest disagreements.

items.title: Matki Pingwinów (Season 2)
items.synopsis: When her seven-year-old son moves to a new school, an MMA fighter realizes that her toughest fight won't be in the octagon, but in parenthood.
items.brief: MMA fighter discovers that parenting her son is tougher than fighting in the octagon.

items.title: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
items.synopsis: In this modern reimagining of the infamous study, 30 people enter a real prison for two weeks and shifting power dynamics expose what they're capable of.
items.brief: Thirty people enter a real prison for two weeks, revealing shifting power dynamics.

items.title: Six Kings Slam (Season 2
items.synopsis: The world's top-ranked players take the court in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia for a star-studded tennis showcase with ultimate bragging rights on the line.
items.brief: The world's top tennis players compete in Riyadh for ultimate bragging rights.

items.title: The Mother of Penguins (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Netflix is an American subscription video on-demand over-the-top streaming media service. The service primarily distributes original and acquired films and television shows from various genres. It is available internationally in multiple languages. Launched in 2007, nearly a decade after Netflix, Inc.…
items.brief: Series exploring penguin motherhood and family dynamics.

items.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Set in Cyberpunk 2077 universe, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners tells a standalone, 10-episode story about a street kid trying to survive in a technology and body modification-obsessed city of the future. Having everything to lose, he chooses to stay alive by becoming an edgerunner—a mercenary outlaw also known as a cyberpunk.
items.brief: Street kid survives a tech-obsessed city by becoming an edgerunner mercenary outlaw.

items.title: Theo Von : I’m Doing Fine
items.synopsis: Comedian and chart-topping podcaster Theo Von returns to Netflix with his third stand-up special and his first in five years. The comedian opens up about the wild world that raised him, from his back-road upbringing to acid-filled adventures, in this revealing stand-up hour.
items.brief: Comedian and chart-topping podcaster Theo Von returns to Netflix with his third stand-up special and his first in five years.

items.title: Organize İşler: Karun Hazinesi
items.synopsis: When a mythical map falls into the hands of a legendary scam artist, he decides to pull one last con before leaving it all behind for good.
items.brief: Legendary scam artist pulls one last con with a mythical map before leaving it all behind.

items.title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
items.synopsis: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.
items.brief: Documentary explores deadpan comedian Norm Macdonald's uncompromising and contradictory life.

items.title: Sacrifice
items.synopsis: Sacrifice follows Daniella Hernandez, a highly sought-after entertainment lawyer, as she navigates the nefarious lives of her rich and famous clients.
items.brief: Entertainment lawyer Daniella Hernandez navigates the nefarious lives of rich and famous clients.

items.title: Seriously Too Single
items.synopsis: Dineo and Noni — besties meant to take on the party scene together — suddenly face their biggest fear when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously propose.
items.brief: Best friends Dineo and Noni face their biggest fear when Noni gets engaged.

items.title: Therapy Done Right
items.synopsis: A psychoanalyst who's lost faith in traditional therapy crosses every boundary to help a blocked novelist in this cutting Argentine dark comedy.
items.brief: Psychoanalyst who lost faith in therapy crosses boundaries to help a blocked novelist.

items.title: The Diplomat (Season 4)
items.synopsis: In the midst of an international crisis, a career diplomat lands in a high-profile job she's unsuited for, with tectonic implications for her marriage and her political future.
items.brief: Career diplomat lands in high-profile job during international crisis, imperiling her marriage.

items.title: Hollywood Arts
items.synopsis: Hollywood Arts follows Trina Vega returning to her old stomping grounds as the newest teacher at Hollywood's most elite performing arts school.
items.brief: Trina Vega returns to her elite performing arts school as its newest teacher.

items.title: The Storm
items.synopsis: The Storm mini-series revolves around a weather creation system developed by the Atmospheric Research Institute that threatens life on Earth when deployed by the military.
items.brief: Military deploys a weather creation system that threatens all life on Earth.

items.title: Hunting Gary Glitter
items.synopsis: A string of dogged journalists chases fugitive pop star Gary Glitter across the globe — from Cuba to Cambodia to Vietnam — determined to expose the child sexual abuse he concealed behind decades of chart-topping fame. This documentary follows their pursuit alongside the survivors who speak out, charting Glitter's 1997 conviction, through to his years on the run, and eventual incarceration.
items.brief: Journalists pursue pop star Gary Glitter globally to expose decades of hidden child sexual abuse.

items.title: Sumukhi Suresh Hoemonal
items.synopsis: Singlehood, relationships with parents and facing taboos — Sumukhi Suresh doesn't hold back as she tackles all this and more in her comedy special.
items.brief: Comedian Sumukhi Suresh tackles singlehood, family relationships, and cultural taboos.

items.title: Love Village (Season 3)
items.synopsis: Singles 35 and over of various backgrounds relocate to a house in the countryside for another chance at love. Will they find "the one" — or leave alone?
items.brief: Singles 35 and over relocate to a countryside house for another chance at love.

items.title: Die Falle
items.synopsis: A reclusive writer catches sight of her sister's murderer on TV. She knows no one will believe her — so she lays a trap to catch the killer herself.
items.brief: Reclusive writer spots her sister's murderer on TV and lays a trap to catch him.

items.title: Tyson
items.synopsis: In this surprisingly emotional documentary, heavyweight champ Mike Tyson analyzes the controversies surrounding his career and turbulent private life.
items.brief: Heavyweight champion Mike Tyson analyzes controversies and his turbulent private life.

items.title: Michael Che : Shot in Minnesota
items.synopsis: Michael Che takes aim at racism, marriage, free speech and everything in between.
items.brief: Comedian Michael Che discusses racism, marriage, free speech, and more.

items.title: WWE Monday Night RAW (Season 33)
items.synopsis: WWE Monday Night RAW is World Wrestling Entertainment's (formerly the WWF and the WWWF before that) premiere wrestling event and brand. Since its launch in 1993, WWE Monday Night RAW continues to air live on Monday nights. It is generally seen as the company's flagship program due to its prolific history, high ratings, weekly live format, and emphasis on pay-per-views. Monday Night RAW is high profile enough to attract frequent visits from celebrities who usually serve as guest hosts for a single live event. Since its first episode, the show has been broadcast live or recorded from more than 197 different arenas in 165 cities and towns in seven different nations: including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom twice a year, Afghanistan for a special Tribute to the Troops, Germany, Japan, Italy and Mexico.
items.brief: WWE's flagship weekly wrestling show featuring live matches and celebrity guests.

items.title: Instadocs
items.synopsis: Instadocs is a fast-turnaround documentary series that takes you to the very center of the loudest headlines, immersing you in the facts and feelings of the moment. It tackles a wide range of gripping current events, crises, and cultural moments. Every installment moves at the speed of each real-life story and arrives at the height of the conversation.
items.brief: Fast-turnaround documentary series covering current events and cultural moments at news speed.

items.title: Free Leonard Peltier
items.synopsis: Leonard Peltier, one of the surviving leaders of the American Indian Movement, has been in prison for 50 years following a contentious conviction. A new generation of Native activists is committed to winning his freedom before he dies.
items.brief: Indigenous activist Leonard Peltier imprisoned for 50 years; activists fight for his freedom.

items.title: The Great Indian Kapil Show (Season 5)
items.synopsis: Comedian Kapil Sharma hosts this laugh-out-loud variety talk show with celebrity guests, hilarious antics and his signature supporting cast.
items.brief: Comedian Kapil Sharma hosts variety talk show with celebrity guests and comedy sketches.

items.title: Screwballs (Season 6)
items.synopsis: Five siblings face endless missions in this pure entertainment variety show. With a few screws loose, they embrace chaos in their search for sanity.
items.brief: Five siblings face entertainment missions while embracing chaos and searching for sanity.

items.title: 100 Days of Deception (Season 1)
items.synopsis: Set in Gyeongseong during the Japanese colonial period, the drama follows Ga Gyeong, the city's most talented pickpocket, who strikes a dangerous deal with the independence army and goes undercover at the Japanese Government-General of Joseon. Disguised as an employee, she is tasked with acting as a "fake spy" for just 100 days, but her mission slowly turns her into a real informant caught between survival, loyalty, and conviction.
items.brief: Pickpocket Ga Gyeong goes undercover as a spy for the independence army in 1940s Gyeongseong.

items.title: Haunted Hotel (Season 2)
items.synopsis: A single mother of two struggles to run a haunted hotel with the help of her estranged brother, who is now one of the ghosts haunting the hotel and thinks the other ghosts have some pretty good ideas.
items.brief: Single mother runs haunted hotel with help from her estranged brother, now a ghost.

items.title: Is It Cake? Halloween (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Cake or fake? Trick or treat? Skilled bakers whip up hyperrealistic Halloween cakes in this seasonal special edition of the hit competition series.
items.brief: Skilled bakers craft hyperrealistic Halloween cakes in this seasonal competition special.

items.title: Take Charge of My Heart
items.synopsis: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.
items.brief: Corporate heir with artificial heart meets an electric woman in a deal that changes everything.

items.title: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure (Season 2)
items.synopsis: America, 1890. Johnny Joestar, a genius jockey now paralyzed from the waist down, chases after outlaw Gyro Zeppeli in a tough cross-continent horse race.
items.brief: Paralyzed jockey Johnny Joestar chases outlaw Gyro Zeppeli across a continent in a horse race.

items.title: The Adam Ray Show
items.synopsis: Same host. Different characters. All chaos. Each week, Adam Ray taps into his roster of alter egos to interview famous guests — and no one is safe.
items.brief: Host Adam Ray uses character alter egos to interview famous guests in chaotic weekly episodes.

items.title: Aquel
items.synopsis: The origins, career and music of Spanish singer Raphael inspire this intimate biopic series about his remarkable journey to 60 years of global success.
items.brief: Series about Spanish singer Raphael's career spanning 60 years of global success.

items.title: Least Eligible Bachelor
items.synopsis: A bachelor struggling to find a bride because of his looks moves to Hyderabad for a fresh start, only to discover that his potential match is his colleague at work.
items.brief: Bachelor struggles with his looks, moves to Hyderabad for a fresh start and workplace romance.

items.title: Animals
items.synopsis: Animals. focuses on the downtrodden creatures native to Earth's least-habitable environment: New York City. Whether it's lovelorn rats, gender-questioning pigeons or aging bedbugs in the midst of a midlife crisis, the awkward small talk, moral ambiguity and existential woes of non-human urbanites prove startlingly similar to our own.
items.brief: Animated series about downtrodden New York City creatures navigating lovelorn, existential lives.

items.title: Doctor X: Mafia in White (Season 1
items.synopsis: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.
items.brief: Enigmatic brilliant surgeon tackles impossible cases amid a corrupt, ego-driven hospital.

items.title: Unicorn Academy: Secrets Revealed (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Follow Sophia and her friends as they embark on a glimmering quest to unlock Unicorn Island's mysteries and banish Grimoria — and Ravenzella — for good!
items.brief: Sophia and friends unlock Unicorn Island's mysteries and banish evil forces.

items.title: Below
items.synopsis: Calvin Penney is a big hearted but stubborn fisherman living in a small Newfoundland town, who's still haunted by his father's mysterious death from decades ago. When an unidentified sea creature begins terrorizing his hometown, Calvin must fight to hold his close-knit community together. Determined to keep his son Wade and the rest of his family safe, he teams up with a visiting marine researcher to confront the creature and reveal the island's buried secrets before it's too late. Blending local myth, thrilling suspense, and heartfelt humor, this twisty six-part limited series dives into themes of family, community, and change - both terrifying and inevitable.
items.brief: Fisherman Calvin confronts a mysterious sea creature terrorizing his Newfoundland town.

items.title: Maschi veri (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Four old friends, Massimo, Mattia, Luigi and Riccardo, juggle relationships, careers and dating in a modern world set on giving masculinity a hard time.
items.brief: Four friends juggle relationships and careers as modern masculinity faces questioning.

items.title: El círculo
items.synopsis: Four friends whose lives unravel after one of them posts a video implicating the Secretary of Defense in the murder of a famous actress. As they dig deeper, they find themselves entangled in a dangerous web of power, secrets, and betrayal.
items.brief: Four friends' lives unravel after one posts a video implicating the Defense Secretary in murder.

items.title: L'Arène
items.synopsis: Ciryl Gane, Cédric Doumbè and Benoît Saint Denis put 38 amateur fighters through brutal tests and cage bouts for a shot at €100,000 and a pro MMA contract.
items.brief: Three fighters test amateur competitors for €100,000 and a professional MMA contract.

items.title: Love is Blind: Nederland
items.synopsis: Nicolette van Dam and Bas Smit host this social experiment where Dutch singles date and get engaged sight unseen to discover whether love truly is blind.
items.brief: Dutch singles date sight-unseen to discover whether love truly is blind.

items.title: Allegedly with Ellison Barber
items.synopsis: Hosted weekly by journalist Ellison Barber, this gripping podcast digs into the most captivating and talked about true crime cases.
items.brief: Journalist Ellison Barber hosts a podcast about captivating true crime cases.

items.title: Less of a Stranger
items.synopsis: As the leader of Polish rock band Lady Pank, Jan Borysewicz shapes a generation with his music, while a string of family tragedies shapes him.
items.brief: Band leader Jan Borysewicz shapes a generation with music while family tragedies shape him.

items.title: Who Is Martin Mull?
items.synopsis: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.
items.brief: Documentary explores Martin Mull's reinvention from folk clubs to sitcoms to gallery walls.

items.title: Mojo Brookzz: I Know You Lying
items.synopsis: Scene-stealer Mojo Brookzz unloads on freaky partners, wild BBL culture and his niece's big coming-out present in his debut Netflix special.
items.brief: Comedian Mojo Brookzz's debut special discusses freaky partners and BBL culture.

items.title: Kian's Bizarre B&B (Season 2)
items.synopsis: On a remote island, Kian84 hosts a quirky B&B escape, where BTS' Jin and Ji Ye-eun lead guests through playful exploits and delightful chaos.
items.brief: Host Kian84 runs quirky island B&B with BTS' Jin and guests experiencing playful chaos.
